info.title: Orbit Field API
info.description:
Offline-first inspection platform. Every endpoint is scoped to the caller’s organisation; a record belonging to another company answers 404 rather than 403, because confirming that it exists is itself a disclosure.

This document is generated from the running application’s routes and validation schemas, so it cannot describe an endpoint the server does not have.

bearerAuth.description: An access token from `POST /api/v1/auth/login`. Endpoints that synchronise also require the `X-Device-Id` header naming an enrolled device.
